name: aidoctor
description: AIDoctor — the multi-language coding harness for AI agents. 11 skills orchestrate AI-slop review across any code: write-time prevention, diff review, whole-project audit. v1.1 ships deep rule packs for Python (25), React (19), Rust (22), JavaScript/TypeScript (21), and Go (20) — 107 rules across 5 languages. LLM-only fallback for any other language. Same harness in Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode.
